# The Urlcade

> A URL-encoded virtual console: every game cartridge is fully described by
> the URL fragment on its link, decoded and run by a single self-contained
> HTML runtime. No server, no build step, no install — copy a link, the
> recipient gets the exact game.

## Spec & reference runtime

- [DESIGN.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/DESIGN.md): The full format spec — binary cart layout, the stack-machine VM and opcode table, and the composable generators (palette/map/HUD/camera) shared across cart types.
- [v0-README.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/v0-README.md): What the V0 reference runtime actually built against the spec, including real bugs found and fixed and deliberate V0 scope cuts.

## Worked examples

- [examples/flappy-bird.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/flappy-bird.md): Dogfooding the format against a Flappy Bird clone.
- [examples/race-car.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/race-car.md): Dogfooding the format against a top-down racer.
- [examples/three-more-carts.md](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/spec/examples/three-more-carts.md): Design-level sketches for a roguelike, a platformer, and an arena shooter.

## Try it

- [Play](https://canyonturtle.github.io/games/): The live runtime with four playable cartridges (Flappy Bird, a racer, a roguelike, a platformer).
